name: 氛围星光Drowned
lyrics:
[主歌1]

City lights 消逝 slow
Nobody walks these roads
Rain 降临 on broken stone
I'm the only ghost left home

[副歌]

We drowned in 星光, you and I
Sinking beneath the urban 潮汐
Whispers of waves, the 寒冷 deep sea
The 星辰 drowned slow, no more to be

[主歌2]

Footsteps echo, no reply
Streets remember, I forget why
Towers bleed into the 天空
Silences grow, the minutes die

[副歌]

We drowned in 星光, you and I
Sinking beneath the urban 潮汐
Whispers of waves, the 寒冷 deep sea
The 星辰 drowned slow, no more to be

[桥段]

Deep down, where no 光芒 can find
The memory of a quieter 时间

[Final Chorus]
We drowned in 星光, you and I
Sinking beneath the urban 潮汐
Fade to 寂静, nothing to see
Just the ocean remembering me

name: 梦幻星光Bleeds
lyrics:
[主歌1]

之间 the dark and the 崩裂 day,
Where the 寂静 holds what words can't say,
A 低语 drifts 穿过 the endless 夜,
Carrying 梦境 that fade to 光芒

[副歌]

In the space where the 星光 渗透,
穿过 the 裂缝 of all our desperate needs,
We are 漂浮, we are falling slow,
In the glow of a dream we don't want to know.

[主歌2]

The fog rolls in before the 黎明,
Like memories of something gone,
A 银色 thread 之间 two worlds,
Where broken hearts are still unfurled.

[副歌]

In the space where the 星光 渗透,
穿过 the 裂缝 of all our desperate needs,
We are 漂浮, we are falling slow,
In the glow of a dream we don't want to know.

[桥段]

And when the first 光芒 breaks the 天空,
We open our eyes and wonder why,
The 夜 was real, the 黎明 is not,
Some things are lost and some are not.

[尾声]

漂浮 falling... dissolving into 光芒

name: 梦幻EphemeralHaze
lyrics:
[主歌1]

Softly the 夜 folds its wings,
Carrying 寂静 on 银色 strings,
Where shadows 低语 and memories bleed,
Into the space 之间 need and deed.

[副歌]

Ephemeral haze in the pale 湛蓝 光芒,
Dissolving the boundaries 之间 day and 夜,
We float on the 边缘 of a dream never true,
In the mist of the morning, I'm losing you.

[主歌2]

Fingers of fog 穿过 the hollow air,
Echoes of moments we couldn't share,
The 星辰 have熄灭 but the 天空 still glows,
As the world holds its breath before it wakes.

[副歌]

Ephemeral haze in the pale 湛蓝 光芒,
Dissolving the boundaries 之间 day and 夜,
We float on the 边缘 of a dream never true,
In the mist of the morning, I'm losing you.

[桥段]

Slowly, slowly the dark begins to thin,
A 低语 of color seeps back in,
The haze holds the secrets the daylight won't keep,
In the space 之间 sleeping and 清醒 we 沉睡

[副歌]

Ephemeral haze in the pale 湛蓝 光芒,
Dissolving the boundaries 之间 day and 夜,
We float on the 边缘 of a dream never true,
In the mist of the morning... I'm losing you.
